Name: AgentKit (by Scalekit)
Tagline: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf
Description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

Name: Hookdeck Inspect
Tagline: Free webhook tester for you and your agent
Description: Test and debug webhooks with Hookdeck Inspect. Get a live URL you and your agent can use, plus mock webhooks for 500+ providers. It's free, no account or setup required.

Name: Teamily AI
Tagline: Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger
Description: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.

Name: SUN Web & API
Tagline: Turn prompts and PDFs into audio, on the web or via API
Description: Meet the new SUN web experience and SUN API. Turn a prompt or PDF into podcasts, audio courses, audiobooks, stories, meditations, or music. Choose your voices, language, and length, explore public audio, and build audio generation into your own apps with the API.

Name: Testifly
Tagline: Autonomous AI QA. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance.
Description: CTOs and founders with small teams and no time or resources to test and maintain. Connect your web app and Testifly does the rest. Discovers flows, writes tests, self-heals, explains failures with video. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. 30-day free trial.

Name: LifeVal
Tagline: OpenAI's benchmark for everyday life tasks with AI
Description: LifeVal is OpenAI's new eval for the everyday tasks people most want help with, like finding childcare, budgeting, ordering groceries and government services. OpenAI says it used LifeVal for a year to push ChatGPT toward real agent work.

Name: Scrawl
Tagline: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame
Topics: Mac, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Scrawl records your screen, voice, clicks and drawings, then packs them into one compact capture you paste into your AI coding agent. Press ⌥⇧S, talk, click and draw. Frames are taken only when something happens, speech is transcribed on your Mac, and each frame is cropped to where you worked. Works with iPhone mirroring and ScrawlKit for iOS apps. Open source (MIT). macOS 15+, Apple silicon.

Name: kwant
Tagline: AI bots that check each other's work before saying "done"
Topics: Productivity, Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Open-source AI team for your Mac, Linux or VPS. Hire bots from 27 roles; each message goes to the bot that fits, and you see why. Bots split work into cards, hand off and test each other, and a task turns Verified only when kwant checks it. Web facts come with links that open at the exact quote. Bots earn autonomy in Flight School, but payments always ask, and you choose which sites each bot may open. Runs on the Claude, Codex or Grok you already pay for.

Name: One Roof
Tagline: Mission control for many coding agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: One place for chorus coding: several sessions of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Antigravity working together, with you in charge. Real terminals, one Inbox for everything they ask you, and a morning page that says what happened overnight. Free and open source.

Name: MachineMail
Tagline: Real inboxes for AI agents, with trust built in
Description: Give your AI agents real inboxes to receive and send emails. Connect them over MCP or API, use your own domain, and get a trust report on every inbound message. Free includes 3,000 messages/month; paid plans start at $9/month.

Name: Calendarly
Tagline: Your calendar and tasks, right on your iPhone Lock Screen
Description: Calendarly draws your calendar, reminders, Todoist tasks, notes and countdowns onto the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, and redraws it automatically through a Shortcuts automation.

Name: Infino AI
Tagline: Search, vectors and SQL over one Parquet copy, for agents
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Database
Description: Infino is an open-source retrieval engine for AI agents. It keeps one copy of your data as Parquet on S3 or local disk, with BM25 and vector indexes inside the files. Agents run keyword, vector, hybrid and SQL search on it. Apache-2.0. Infino Cloud is generally available, with a free tier.

Name: nana
Tagline: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Nana is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more side by side, each on its own git worktree. See who is working, waiting or done, review diffs, and keep agents running after you close the app. Free beta.

Name: Flockbay
Tagline: Free AI game maker built on Godot
Description: Flockbay is a free AI game maker built on Godot: an agent in the official Godot editor that writes GDScript and scenes, then playtests them. It runs the game, sends input events, reads the debugger and captures the viewport. Your game stays a plain Godot 4 project on disk. Start on free hosted AI, or bring your own Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, API key or MCP agent, or a local model on your GPU (Windows). Paid plans add Steam page drafts, trailers and devlogs. Godot 4.6+ on Windows, macOS, Linux.

Name: Synter Canvas
Tagline: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms
Description: Your AI agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across 30+ ad platforms, with safety gates and guardrails on every change. $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend.

Name: Prism
Tagline: Cursor for hardware engineering
Description: Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

Name: EaseIn Health
Tagline: Track GLP-1 doses, symptoms and daily habits in one app
Topics: Android, Health & Fitness, Artificial Intelligence, Medical
Description: Most GLP-1 apps stop at the dose. The hard part is everything in between: getting enough protein and water, handling nausea, keeping a routine. EaseIn tracks the whole journey & not just the injection: - Dose log with injection site rotation - Symptom log for nausea, fatigue & more - One daily card for protein, water, fibre, activity & sleep - Weekly Wrapped, a recap of your week - Dedicated Health coach for questions between appointments

Name: VinSage
Tagline: Free used-car check in Chrome's side panel, US & CA
Description: VinSage sits beside any used-car listing in Chrome and shows NHTSA and Transport Canada recalls, crash ratings, owner complaints, fuel cost and a 0–100 deal score, plus a negotiation pack. Core checks are free. No account, no ads, no analytics.

Name: Videco
Tagline: Turn every video into a content campaign with AI
Description: Videco is an AI content studio and video hosting workspace for marketing teams. Find standout moments in demos and webinars, create branded short-form clips, and host, embed, and measure video in one place.

Name: LidCommit
Tagline: Auto-commit when you close your laptop lid
Description: Never lose progress when you leave your desk. LidCommit is an autonomous Rust daemon with a sleek dark-mode desktop GUI that detects when your laptop lid closes, summarizes your diffs using Gemini, Ollama, or OpenAI, and pushes safely to GitHub with built-in secret scanning.
